lines.t: Give heed to My words, embrace My correction
That you may see with greater eyes, renewed reflection
Have you forgotten this truth, spoken through My hand?
No prophecy or scripture stands by one alone to understand
For prophecy never comes by the will of man
Those chosen received ears to hear
By My spirit, by My will,
They became mouthpieces of The Most High God, standing near
All I speak is Scripture and Truth
A plumb line by which the crooked paths are straightened anew
Hear and understand,
The love and severity of God shines through
For those who forsake Me, trample upon My name
Reject The Holy One of Israel, turning away in shame
Great adversity and refinement in the Day of The Lord
Yet for those who embrace Me and cleave to My Word
Sanctuary is given, escape in My love
The house of The Lord is refuge above
My word is for all who seek, longing to know My ways
Abide in My commandments, walk out the truth all days
The world offers seductive songs, leading the heart astray
But My Word is a purifying flame, calling you My way
The spirit moves, My chosen hear
All I speak becomes a sword that divides
A rod for the faithful, a staff for those who believe
Let the crooked paths be set right, let the blind perceive
For those who forsake Me, trample upon My name
Reject The Holy One of Israel, turning away in shame
Great adversity and refinement in the Day of The Lord
Yet for those who embrace Me and cleave to My Word
Sanctuary is given, escape in My love
The house of The Lord is refuge above
Therefore, watch, and listen, be spared
For I am coming quickly, in power declared
All things restored, all tears wiped away
Only life enduring, in My spirit you’ll stay
